data.title: 德尔塔 · 赤岩峡谷的狂暴飞斩
data.description: 辽阔险峻的赤红峡谷裂隙间，狂风卷起沙砾。德尔塔手握重型史莱姆巨剑从峭壁飞跃下扑，犬耳紧贴，嘴角挂着野性兴奋的尖牙狞笑。
data.location: vast red rock canyon chasm under sweeping windy cloudy sky
data.action: leaping dynamically through the air from a canyon ledge, wielding a giant dark slime cleaver overhead, tail streaming, wild fanged grin
data.lighting: 风沙散射金光与侧面硬光
data.promptProse: Delta leaps ferociously across a desert canyon chasm swinging a massive dark slime greatsword, ears pinned back with a fierce fanged battle grin.
data.animaCaption: Desert wind and dust whirl around her leaping figure as she swings the giant cleaver.
